_comment: THE ONLY DEFINITION OF A TRAILER (docs/trailers.md): a project's short film, drawn frame by frame in
Builda's own design language by trailer/ (Node), from what the Mac knows about the project: its demo
(the screens it filmed), its numbers, its commits since the last demo and its build post. A trailer is
a CUT, a list of scenes with their words and timing, and a render of that cut in every social format of
spec/devices.v1.json. The director (the chat on the project page) changes the cut, never the pixels: a
note from the phone becomes a new cut, the cut a new render, and every cut is kept so any version can
come back. scripts/gen_trailer.py emits capture/trailer/tables.py (standard library, the Mac),
(the door, Pydantic) and mobile/src/generated/trailer.ts. Never hand-edit the output.
A refusal is a code with its sentence in `refusals`; a change is a code with its sentence in
`changes`, where {before} and {after} are the change's own values. The phone words the Mac's answer to a
note from these, so the answer to 'make it shorter' is '20 s became 14 s', never prose a model wrote.

refusals.not_understood: that note did not ask for a change the trailer can make; try the length, the pace, the colour, the words or the order
refusals.no_model: only the simple changes work without claude on your Mac: the length, the pace, the colour, the words and the order
refusals.invented_number: the change would have put a number on screen your project never gave, so it was not made
refusals.names_a_repository: the change would have named a private repository on screen, so it was not made
refusals.needs_new_capture: that needs new screens filmed; ask for a new demo and the trailer will be cut from it
refusals.over_limit: those words run past what fits on screen, so they were not changed
refusals.no_such_version: there is no version with that number
refusals.render_failed: the new cut could not be rendered, so the last version stays
refusals.no_trailer: this project has no trailer yet; it is cut from the project's demo
refusals.no_node: cutting a trailer needs Node 22.18 or later on your Mac
refusals.no_demo: this project has no demo to cut a trailer from yet

changes.title: the title reads “{after}”
changes.rerendered: cut again from the latest demo

words._comment: How a change's value is said. A scene, a figure, a mood, a camera or a transition travels as its code and is said with these words, in the phone's sentence and on the Mac.

Cut.name: version
Cut.doc: 1-1000 1 for the first cut, one more for every change after it.

Cut.name: seconds
Cut.doc: How long the whole trailer runs, within `seconds` min and max. The scenes share it by their weight.

Cut.name: pace
Cut.doc: How quickly things move inside a scene, within `pace` min and max. 1 is the app's own springs.

Cut.name: hue
Cut.doc: The project's colour: the band, the ink, the end card.

Cut.name: creature
Cut.doc: The creature printed on the opening band and the end card.

Cut.name: mood
Cut.doc: The score under it, or none.

Cut.name: transition
Cut.doc: How one scene gives way to the next.

Cut.name: title
Cut.doc: The project's name on the opening band and the end card.

Cut.name: line
Cut.doc: One line under the title: what the project is, in a few words.

Cut.name: cta
Cut.doc: The last card's line: where to get it.

Cut.name: scenes
Cut.doc: The scenes in order. The first is always open and the last always end.

Text.name: text
Text.doc: The words as they are drawn. No dash of any kind.

Text.name: source
Text.doc: facts: from the project; person: typed by its owner; model: written by claude from the facts.

Scene.name: weight
Scene.doc: Its share of the trailer's seconds against the other scenes' weights, within `weight` min and max.

Scene.name: arrival
Scene.doc: How its pixels arrive: one of the app's eight orders.

Scene.name: beats
Scene.doc: screens scenes only: which of the demo's beats (or stills) it shows, by position from 0, in order.

Scene.name: camera
Scene.doc: screens scenes only: how the device moves.

Scene.name: caption
Scene.doc: A caption the scene draws under its own words, if any.

Change.name: before
Change.doc: The value before, as its code or number.

Change.name: after
Change.doc: The value after, as its code or number.

CutEdit.name: cut
CutEdit.doc: The whole new cut, when the note asked for something the cut can do. Everything the note did not ask about stays exactly as it was.

CutEdit.name: changes
CutEdit.doc: Every difference between the old cut and the new one, one per thing changed.

CutEdit.name: refusal
CutEdit.doc: Set instead of a cut when the note cannot be done by changing the cut.
